title: Robert Half's Angela Lurie and Sara Gagen named to SIA's 2026 Global Power 150 Women in Staffing
summary: Staffing Industry Analysts has named Robert Half leaders Angela Lurie and Sara Gagen to its 2026 Global Power 150 Women in Staffing, which recognizes women making a significant impact on the...
body_markdown:
MENLO PARK, Calif.


, Oct. 13, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Staffing Industry Analysts has named Robert Half leaders Angela Lurie and Sara Gagen to its[2026 Global Power 150 Women in Staffing](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4796890-1&h=2552146823&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.staffingindustry.com%2Fnews%2Fglobal-daily-news%2Fnew-sia-global-power-150-honors-female-leaders-from-across-the-industry&a=2026+Global+Power+150+Women+in+Staffing) , which recognizes women making a significant impact on the staffing industry. Lurie was honored for her leadership of Robert Half's Management Resources practice group, while Gagen was recognized for advancing technology and business transformation across the organization.


"Angela and Sara are exceptional leaders who continue to move our organization and industry forward," said M. Keith Waddell, President and Chief Executive Officer of Robert Half. "Their commitment to innovation, collaboration and developing high-performing teams reflects our values and continued success."


[Angela Lurie](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4796890-1&h=2834817892&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.staffingindustry.com%2Flists%2Fglobal-power-150-women-in-staffing%2F2026-global-power-150-women-in-staffing%2Fentrants%2Fangela-lurie&a=Angela+Lurie) , Global Executive Director of Robert Half's Management Resources group, leads a business with more than 140 locations worldwide. Since joining Robert Half in 1999, she has built and developed high-performing teams while leading the company's practice groups to achieve significant growth. Previously, as senior vice president of the company's Full-Time Engagement Professionals program, she helped expand the initiative into a global offering that now includes thousands of professionals across multiple specializations.


[Sara Gagen](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4796890-1&h=2426169085&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.staffingindustry.com%2Flists%2Fglobal-power-150-women-in-staffing%2F2026-global-power-150-women-in-staffing%2Fentrants%2Fsara-gagen&a=Sara+Gagen) , Senior Vice President of Applications, Technology and Innovation, has led programs supporting Robert Half's business transformation for more than 15 years. She oversees teams and initiatives spanning cloud solutions, Salesforce innovation, marketing technology, engineering, business systems analysis and quality services. Her 500-person team helps deliver technology solutions that support the company's operations and continued innovation.


The complete 2026 Global Power 150 list is available at[Staffing Industry Analysts](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4796890-1&h=3898508096&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.staffingindustry.com%2Flists%2Fglobal-power-150-women-in-staffing%2F2026-global-power-150&a=Staffing+Industry+Analysts) .


**FAQs**
**What is SIA's Global Power 150?**
Staffing Industry Analysts' annual Global Power 150 recognizes women whose leadership, achievements and influence are making a significant impact on their organizations and the staffing industry.


**Which Robert Half leaders were named to the 2026 Global Power 150?**
Angela Lurie, Global Executive Director of Robert Half's Management Resources group, and Sara Gagen, Senior Vice President of Applications, Technology and Innovation, were named to Staffing Industry Analysts' 2026 Global Power 150.


**Why were these leaders recognized?**
Angela Lurie was recognized for leading global business growth and developing high-performing teams across Robert Half's talent solutions operations. Sara Gagen was honored for advancing technology innovation and business transformation while building teams that support collaboration and professional development.
